title: Jimmy Mundy and the 'Cavernism' arrangement
summary: At the start of reel 2 Wilson recalls Mundy joining Hines and writing 'Cavernism', which Wilson later arranged for Willie Bryant.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose

You were saying Jimmy Mundy joined the band.
Yeah, Jimmy Mundy came with the band.
We can verify that easily because Budd Johnson is here with us.
Right. But Jimmy left to go with Goodman later on, as I recall. Jimmy Mundy became the mainstay of the Benny Goodman arranging staff, along with Fletcher Henderson and Edgar Sampson.
But I know Jimmy Mundy was in there because Jimmy did an original thing for Earl Hines that impressed me so much called 'Cavernism'.
I remember I wrote that "Cavernism" arrangement for Willie Bryant's band, after I joined Willie Bryant -- I liked "Cavernism" so much ...
